heading: School Board Reviews Spring College Credit Requests
summary: District staff presented spring 2027 requests for the Early College Credit and Start College Now programs. Board members asked about barriers such as course prerequisites and conflicts with high school schedules. They also discussed what students may owe when they withdraw from or fail a course.

heading: Wisconsin Releases State Government Improvement Report
source: Wisconsin Department of Administration press release
summary: The governor and Department of Administration released the 2026 Enterprise Continuous Improvement Program Report. The report highlights changes agencies made to their operations and the savings they reported. The state's Strategic Management and Planning team compiled it.
